author: Top Gear
description:
The new Audi RS5 Avant is rather good. In fact, it does a decent impression of an R35 Nissan GT-R, what with its twin-turbo V6 and 4WD system. But how does it stack up against its best predecessor, the B7-generation, V8-engined RS4 Avant. In short, which is peak Audi super-wagon? 

🚗 Audi RS5 & (B7) Audi RS4 Avant
🎤 Ollie Kew
